title: Playtest request: Is the first minute of INFEST clear to a new player?
author: Illustrious-Lake2603
selftext:
I’m working on INFEST: The Arcade, a Unity game that brings Galaga-style enemy formations into a 3D arcade shooter. The demo is free, and I’d love feedback from people seeing it for the first time.



One concrete example of where AI helped: I used Claude to trace why some voxel pilots looked fine on PC but stretched into an accordion in the lightweight browser build. The simplified meshes were assigning whole blocks the same bone weights. Transferring weights from the full mesh by matching vertex positions gave the simplified models smoother movement. That made comparing the same pose on the full and simplified models a much better check than just seeing whether the build compiled.



If you have a minute, try the browser demo. Was it obvious how to start a run and what to do once it loaded? If anything made you stop or hesitate, I’d love to know where. If the browser build stutters or an animation looks off, your browser and device would help me reproduce it.



Free demo: [https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade](https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade)
